## Outcome

Produce one production-ready Axum hot-reload implementation.

## Primary deliverable

One production-ready Axum hot-reload implementation with last-known-good retention, including Runtime Observatory origin-policy reload.

Valid reload, invalid retention, debounce, concurrent-read, watcher-shutdown, and live origin-policy reload tests pass.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one production-ready hot-reload implementation; behavioral cases are proof inputs.

## Dependencies

- WP-01: #480
- Runtime origin-policy input and operational need: #540 / PR #543 follow-up

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

- [ ] Reads use atomically swappable state
- [ ] Invalid updates preserve the last valid configuration
- [ ] File events are debounced
- [ ] Concurrent requests observe complete configurations only
- [ ] `observatory.allowed_origins` and `observatory.additional_allowed_origins` are parsed, normalized, validated, and atomically swapped as one Runtime origin-policy snapshot
- [ ] Editing only the Runtime configuration can add or remove an exact allowed origin without rebuilding, rotating continuity state, or restarting Runtime
- [ ] Runtime HTTP CORS and authenticated WSS admission read the current origin-policy snapshot for each new request/session
- [ ] Invalid, wildcard, path-bearing, credential-bearing, duplicate, or otherwise unsafe origin edits retain the complete last-known-good policy
- [ ] Concurrent traffic observes either the complete old origin set or the complete new origin set, never a partial mixture

- `debounce`
- `concurrent-read`
- `watcher-shutdown`
- `origin-policy-live-reload`

- Reload requires process restart
- Reload requires continuity rotation or a Runtime rebuild
- Partial configuration can become visible

- Invalid origin configuration replaces the last-known-good policy
